collider.pdp: Delivery cut-off ('Order within X to get delivery by Tuesday') + what's-in-the-box list. Copy for live-fish shipping days.
collider.pdp-details: Us vs Them comparison grid - use for 'our live-arrival guarantee vs local pet shop'.

bloom.pdp: Round image swatches tagged NEW + Single/2/3 Pack chips + subscribe & save cards -> guppy strain swatches + Pair/Trio/Group of 6 chips.

people4ocean.product-card: Sold Out / Coming Soon states inline with one-tap add - use for strains/batches that come and go.

giordanos.bundle-builder: Bundle builder on an Impact-theme build (Electric Eye).

brooklinen.bundle-builder: Build-your-bundle with compare + review proof (desktop + mobile combined).

metabu.hero: Headless rebuild by Acqurio Tech; AI shade-finder quiz + try-on live on site.

nasher-miles.hero: Single bold promise ('Every trip needs a co-pilot') + category tiles (Handbags/Sets/Backpacks/Accessories) above the banner on mobile so shoppers pick a lane in one tap. Guppy store: tiles for Guppy pairs / Trios / Starter kits / Food & care above a hero promising 'Live arrival guaranteed'.
nasher-miles.header: Compact mobile header with search, account and cart always visible plus a 'New' badge on the hot nav item. Use a 'New strain' badge on the nav link to your latest guppy drop.
nasher-miles.product-card: Cards with a % off flag and clean cut-out images on white; 'New Arrivals / Best Sellers' toggle above the grid. For fish: 'Best sellers' vs 'New strains' toggle, and a 'Pair'/'Trio' flag on each card.
nasher-miles.pdp: Dimensions diagram as the 2nd image, colour swatches, big orange ADD TO CART and a 4-icon trust strip (free shipping, quality-tested, hassle-free returns, support). For guppies: 2nd image = adult size/colour diagram (male vs female), trust strip = Live-arrival guarantee / Insulated packing / Ships Mon-Wed / WhatsApp support.
nasher-miles.pdp-details: Annotated lifestyle images (callouts like 'Water resistant', 'Easy grab handles') explain features without walls of text. Annotate a tank photo: 'tail type', 'adult size 3-4 cm', 'temp 24-28°C', 'community-safe'.
nasher-miles.sticky-atc: Sticky bottom bar shows Total + MRP strike + '72% off' chip + '7-day returns, no questions asked' right next to ADD TO CART - the risk reversal sits at the moment of decision. Put 'DOA? Free replacement - photo within 2 hrs' in the same spot.
nasher-miles.footer: Newsletter footer 'Check out of Reality' with one email field. For a fish store: 'Get new-strain drops & shipping-day alerts' signup.

juicy-chemistry.bundle-builder: 'Complete Your Routine' 3-step bundle on the PDP: numbered steps (Exfoliate > Moisturise > Protect), each pre-'ADDED' with its own rating, per-item savings and one ADD TO CART with the total. Lifts AOV because the routine framing makes the add-ons feel necessary. Guppy store: 'Complete your setup' = 1 Acclimate (water conditioner) > 2 Feed (guppy food) > 3 Thrive (guppy trio), pre-ticked, one button with the bundle total.
juicy-chemistry.pdp: Image-led PDP with certification badges (Ecocert, in-vivo tested) and quantified claims on the first image; size chips with price and % off in each chip. For fish: put 'Live arrival guaranteed' + 'Bred in India, quarantined 14 days' badges on the first photo and pair/trio chips with per-fish price.
juicy-chemistry.pdp-details: Ratings count + clinical claim + size selector + qty stepper above ADD TO CART, with 'Pairs well with' cross-sells below. Use 'Pairs well with' for food, breeder box and plants under each strain.
juicy-chemistry.hero: Promo/collab hero with a coupon code in the banner and a persistent offer announcement bar (Buy 3 for 999). Use the bar for the shipping cut-off: 'Order by 12 pm Mon-Wed - ships same day'.
juicy-chemistry.header: Red offer bar + centered logo + mega nav by concern ('Shop by concern', 'Curated rituals'). Fish equivalent: shop by tank size / beginner-friendly / strain.
juicy-chemistry.product-card: Bestseller cards with 'Save x%' flags, star ratings and review counts visible on mobile. Show ratings + 'Live arrival guaranteed' microcopy on each guppy card.
juicy-chemistry.reviews: Rating histogram, 'Write a review / Ask a question' buttons and an AI 'Customers say' summary on top of 10k+ reviews. A summary like 'Customers say: fish arrived healthy, colours as shown' is strong social proof for live animals.

eternal-blue.hero: Full-bleed editorial portrait with one line ('Time-tested botanical knowledge adapted for modern haircare') and a single 'Explore' link - calm, premium, no clutter. For guppies: full-bleed macro shot of a tail in a blue tank with one line about your breeding story.
eternal-blue.header: Minimal transparent header (logo, Cart count, Menu) that floats over imagery. Good for a premium strain-focused store where the fish photos sell.
eternal-blue.pdp: Product on a sky-blue backdrop, short benefit copy, 'free-from' chips (Sulphate-free, Phthalate-free...) and one full-width Add to Cart with the price in the button. Swap chips for 'Tank-bred / Quarantined / Medication-free'.
eternal-blue.pdp-details: Independent results stat ('87.5% of participants rated the products effective') right under the CTA, then expandable Ingredients with a photo per ingredient. For fish: a stat like '98% arrive alive (last 500 orders)' under the button, then expandable Care sheet (temp, pH, diet, tank mates).
eternal-blue.reviews: Clean review wall with photo UGC and a 'Rated 5.0 stars' header + Leave a review button. Ask buyers for unboxing/tank photos - live fish UGC is the strongest proof of healthy arrival.

snitch.pdp: Headless Shopify PDP: model image gallery, colour thumbnails as images, size buttons, black ADD + bag/wishlist/share icons. Use image swatches for each guppy strain variant (male/female/pair).
snitch.pdp-details: Offer chip ('Enjoy 10% off on next order above 5990'), size guide, 'FREE 1-2 day delivery on 5k+ pincodes' and a pincode CHECK for delivery date before ADD. For live fish, a pincode checker that says 'Ships Mon, arrives Wed - live-arrival covered' removes the biggest worry.
snitch.sticky-atc: Mobile sticky black ADD bar stays at the bottom even inside 'You may also like' - add-to-cart is never more than a thumb away.

mokobara.pdp: Colors / Compare tabs on the swatches, an EMI offer strip, Pay in full vs Pay in 4 pricing, and a delivery date plus pincode check right above ADD TO CART.
mokobara.sticky-atc: Sticky full-width ADD TO CART bar on mobile, with delivery date kept visible.

minimalist.cart-drawer: Tiered reward progress bar in the cart drawer (Extra 5% off at ₹599, 10% at ₹899, then a free gift), coupon field, offer list and GoKwik checkout. Copy it as: free heat pack at ₹X, free food at ₹Y.

whole-truth.pdp: 'Select pack size' cards (Box of 6 / 12) with a per-unit price and savings tag, then a pincode delivery check. Pair / Trio / Group cards would work the same way.
whole-truth.pdp-details: Full ingredient list as a % table: radical transparency.

subko.pdp-details: 'Flavour Meter' table rating each attribute on a scale, plus 'Best Brewed With' icons. Turn it into a care meter (temperament, difficulty, tank size) per strain.
subko.sticky-atc: 'Flavour Meter' table rating each attribute on a scale, plus 'Best Brewed With' icons. Turn it into a care meter (temperament, difficulty, tank size) per strain.

blue-tokai.variant-selector: Grind selector chips (French Press, Aeropress…) with roast info.
blue-tokai.pdp: Grind + pack options, an AI coffee-assistant bubble and a pincode check.

sleepy-owl.variant-selector: Round image swatches for brew method / grind.
sleepy-owl.cart-drawer: Cart drawer with mug upsell carousel and a coupon nudge.

koparo.product-card: Large 'Save NN%' callouts on every card.
koparo.variant-selector: Size chips (1L / 3L / 5L) with savings on the larger refills.

bare-necessities.pdp: Starter pack vs refill pack architecture, with a 'how to refill your forever case' accordion.

bummer.variant-selector: Colour swatches plus a size chart link, in loud Gen-Z colours.

supertails.hero: Indian pet-care store built by Dynamic Dreamz: the closest reference for a fish/pet shop.

huft.pdp: Pack-of-1/5/7 tier cards with unit price + % off, flavor swatches, Human-Grade trust pills, coupon box and pincode delivery. Copy for guppy pack sizes + live-arrival guarantee + shipping check.
huft.pdp-details: Benefit/ingredient storytelling below buy box — use for care sheet / water-param trust on live fish.
huft.sticky-atc: Mobile sticky ATC with Watch & Buy video — keep fish unboxing or arrival clips near ATC.
huft.product-card: Pet category cards with ratings and offer badges.
huft.reviews: Dense review block with photos — social proof for live-arrival claims.

nykd.pdp: Colour swatches + dual ATC / Buy Now. Size-gated ATC is the caution; Bra Advisor quiz (Seventh Triangle) is the standout education pattern for 'which fish for my tank'.
nykd.variant-selector: Colour swatches with clear selected state.

arata.pdp: Pack of 1/2/3 cards with MOST POPULAR + FREE gift + SAVE + ALMOST GONE scarcity. Direct template for fish multi-packs / starter kits.
arata.product-card: Bestsellers filters + category tiles on homepage.

ranavat.cart-drawer: Free-shipping/gift progress bar + Complete Your Ritual checkbox upsells + gift note. Copy for aquarium starter-kit AOV and free-shipping thresholds.
ranavat.pdp: Size toggles, Subscribe & Save, Shop Pay, UGC strip under buy box.

renee.cart-drawer: Reward-tier progress bar (free shipping, gifts, % off) pulls order value up; mirror with free live-arrival shipping tiers for fish packs.

katkare.hero: Vet-led trust hero (Doc Polly) + free-shipping announcement. Mirror with aquarist/expert endorsement for live-fish arrivals.
katkare.product-card: Rounded cards with star ratings + unit price (€/L) under pack price — copy for guppy pack cards (₹/fish or ₹/pair).
katkare.pdp: Health-indicator litter PDP: benefit bullets with icons, unit pricing, multi-pack chips with % off. Strong template for fish pack tiers and live-arrival trust copy.
katkare.variant-selector: Pack quantity chips (1–4) with discount badges; subscription vs one-time delivery toggle nearby.
katkare.cart-drawer: Post-ATC confirm modal with subscription cadence ('Lieferung alle 4 Wochen') + checkout CTA. Recurring-delivery pattern for fish food/care add-ons.
katkare.sticky-atc: Mobile sticky ATC on pet PDP.
katkare.reviews: Review strip under buy box builds pet-care trust.

alpine-apothecary.hero: Calm cream/seriffed wellness brand; pain-point headline cards.
alpine-apothecary.product-card: Two large story cards with question headlines ('Can't sleep?'), star ratings, price, full-width CTA — good for curated fish collections with benefit-first copy.
alpine-apothecary.pdp: Trust-led PDP: benefit pills, inline testimonial, clinical social-proof bar, pack options with ₹/night unit pricing. Calm storytelling for premium fish lines.
alpine-apothecary.variant-selector: Starter vs Reset pack cards with per-unit breakdown.
alpine-apothecary.cart-drawer: Clean cream cart drawer with qty stepper and WhatsApp/email help link — low-friction assist before checkout.
alpine-apothecary.sticky-atc: Mobile sticky bar with price + ATC.

rare-rabbit.hero: Premium fashion hero; study for high-end photography + minimal chrome.
rare-rabbit.product-card: Dense fashion grid with hover/quick actions; useful for pack/colour browsing patterns.
rare-rabbit.pdp: 2×2 image grid + sticky buy column, colour swatches, size chips with Notify Me on OOS, PIN delivery check. Size/colour UX transferable to fish colour morph / pack selection.
rare-rabbit.variant-selector: Fabric swatches + size boxes with clear OOS strike-through and Notify Me.
rare-rabbit.sticky-atc: Mobile sticky ATC on fashion PDP.

itokri.header: Dense double-row category nav + 'Search 100,000+' — category IA ideas for fish species/collections.
itokri.product-card: Story-led cards with craft labels and per-metre unit pricing; adapt for curated fish collections and origin tags.
itokri.pdp: Craft badges, scarcity meter ('Only X available'), length selector, free-shipping cue — scarcity + unit measure patterns for limited guppy drops.
itokri.cart-drawer: Free-shipping progress bar, Trustpilot badge, gift-wrap upsell, secure-payment strip. Strong AOV levers for fish packs + free live-arrival shipping thresholds.
itokri.reviews: Excellent 4.7 / 14k reviews carousel with Verified Customer — social proof for live-arrival guarantees.
